company: Cathay Chung Yue Estate Pty Ltd
subject: Graduate Engineer, Marc Masarate
email_body:
Hello,

I'm applying for the Graduate Engineer role in your civil and structural team, advertised on SEEK. The ad welcomes graduates with up to two years' experience for estimating, tender documents and document control, and that is the work my study prepared me for.

I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design in February 2026, where I prepared cost estimates and bills of quantities, reviewed technical drawings, and drew road, earthworks, pavement and stormwater designs in AutoCAD and Civil 3D to Australian Standards. My degree is a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering (Philippines, 2019). On site in the Philippines from April 2019 to February 2020 I reviewed structural and architectural drawings, tracked procurement and materials, kept material records and progress reports, and coordinated with suppliers and subcontractors.

I have no façade experience and no work experience in Australia yet, and I haven't used Aconex or Procore. I use Excel and Word. I hold a White Card, an Australian driver's licence and full working rights until December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa. I'm based in Melton, Victoria and open to discussing relocation to Sydney.

My drawings are at https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio. I'd welcome a conversation about the estimating team.

Kind regards,
Marc Darenz Masarate
0478 764 077

subject: Trainee Traffic Signals Designer, Marc Masarate
email_body:
Hello,

I'm applying for the Trainee Traffic Signals Designer role advertised on SEEK. The ad asks for up to two years in design, drafting or CAD documentation and says signals experience isn't required, which fits me: my design and drafting experience is the two years of my Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design, finished in February 2026.

In that coursework I designed and documented road geometry, earthworks, pavement and stormwater drainage in AutoCAD and Civil 3D to Australian Standards and Austroads guides, and the standards included AS 1742.14, so signals drawings would not be a cold start. My degree is a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering (Philippines, 2019). On site in the Philippines from April 2019 to February 2020 I carried out inspections and checked the work against the drawings.

I have no traffic signal, lighting or ITS experience yet, and my CAD work is from study. I hold an Australian driver's licence, a White Card and full working rights until December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa. I'm based in Melton, Victoria, can travel to South-East Queensland for meetings and inspections, and I'm open to discussing relocation.

My drawings are at https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio. I'd be glad to talk.

Kind regards,
Marc Darenz Masarate
0478 764 077
